ui_match.maturity_data: One initial Day 0; a complete lab row can Generate and save as Draft. Partially entered lab rows stop and focus the missing field.
ui_match.keyboard: Text, decimal, signed temperature, datum choices, date and time with automatic separators
ui_match.datetime: DD-MM-YYYY on panel, YYYY-MM-DD over CM1, HH:MM from acknowledged device clock
ui_match.status_corners: Larger live clock and battery fields and icons
ui_match.touch: One queued tap during a read, checked against session, page, view and record ID
ui_match.selection: Whole saved baseline card, separate delete, ACK-driven highlight and START prerequisites
ui_match.history: Three tappable cards, empty state, page position restored after View Log
ui_match.device_info: Full About text and tappable SET CLOCK
ui_match.chart: 65 MCU curve samples and lab scatter in original and expanded chart
ui_match.realtime_add_day: ADD DAY records current device time and the mean of valid probes in Logged Days
ui_match.sensor_key: Yellow SENSOR on the Maturity Temperature keyboard; uses the row being edited and live validated probe readings.
ui_match.sensor_channels: S1–S3 are ROM discovery slots on shared D2; rescan between conversions every three seconds.
